name: compile media plans for every renderer
from: A script, lesson report or research paper that is to become video, and the renderers that exist (Google Flow queue orders, the procedural microdrama renderer).
to: One admitted media plan, identified by content address, with a verifying compilation receipt that each renderer's adapter consumed; or coded refusals naming what in the plan is wrong.
allowed-effects: write plan protocol files inside a working directory
effect-limits: no Flow queue write, credit hold, upload or publication without a separate person-authorized step

x-provenance.source: Owner request: one shared upstream media contract for Google Flow and the deterministic microdrama renderer; standing rule no-work-outside-an-office-duty-and-skill
x-provenance.note: authority and claim are the nearest existing offices; the claimant (public fiction and education shorts) has no media office. See system-debt record no-media-office-exists-for-the-claim-side.
